post.description: Optional plugin mode emits tool_proposal (PluginToolProposal) before done with finish_reason=tool_calls. By default a proposal is persisted without execution. When automatic_readonly_tools is opted in after capability discovery, the host may complete only its trusted built-in balance/history reads and mark automatic=true; transfers and untrusted remote tools still await confirmation. Clients read the saved invocation and may continue once using completed invocation IDs, after durable history save. Images/resources are displayed natively; raw tool results are not client-supplied model context. Version-1 application mode additionally emits app_tool (AppToolProposal), followed by done with finish_reason=tool_calls. The client may execute only its fixed public read handlers; app_open produces a user-clicked native navigation card. It may continue with at most three bounded AppToolContext records. Reloading history never replays an application tool. Application context is separate from server-owned plugin invocation results.

post.description: Idempotently add or reconnect a fixed provider connection. Tavily optionally selects shared or personal access; omitted mode preserves any existing mode, including revoked connections, otherwise defaults to shared. Changing an active mode requires explicit disconnect first (409 PLUGIN_ACCESS_MODE_CONFLICT). No business calls. Reconnect invalidates earlier credentials and capabilities; authorization remains separate.

access_mode.description: Optional, Tavily only. Explicit modes for other providers are rejected. Personal mode requires an encrypted personal Tavily API key and never falls back to shared access.

post.description: iFinD, Jin10 and Tavily personal-mode connections only. Encrypts credentials bound to owner, connection, revision and endpoint; invalidates old proposals and verifies the tool catalog. Returns saved connection even on verification failure, never the secret. iFinD accepts the exact Authorization value; Jin10 accepts its raw MCP Token; Tavily personal accepts its raw API key and sends Bearer only to the fixed official MCP endpoint, without keyless mode. No automatic retry or anonymous fallback. Third-party 401 never becomes Q-session 401. Requires encryption configuration.

post.description: Recommend against a saved user message in an owned conversation. Server reads at most two completed preceding ordinary rounds and binds a content digest; no client supplied context or plugin results. Deterministic exact match or one low-priority Flash choice from at most 12 candidates, returning 0–3. Total processing budget five seconds with exact-match fallback; does not delay the normal chat. Same request and source digest replay the existing result. No tool execution.

post.description: Recheck account ownership, saved source digest, access, connection revision and capability version. A ready plugin atomically creates or reuses one dedicated conversation per recommendation/candidate and returns its CAS revision. Pending connection/authorization/review opens existing setup; call selection again after returning. Navigation returns only a known module. This endpoint never executes tools. Repeated selection and lost responses restore the existing target and must not auto-repeat its task.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque expiring session token; native clients keep it in SecureStore.

handle.description: Trimmed and lowercased; 3–24 ASCII letters/digits/underscore. xiaoq reserved.

automatic_readonly_tools.description: Host support for explicitly opted-in automatic trusted read-only plugin queries. Missing on older servers; clients must omit the request flag unless true.

app_tools_version.description: Support for version-1 public application tools. Missing on older servers; the client must discover this version before opting in.

company_research_version.description: Optional discovery flag for global public company search and covered annual financial research.

filing_research_version.description: Independent opt-in for verified SEC primary HTML filing lists and paragraph text. Requires app_tools_version 1; absent on older servers.

recommendations_version.description: 1 enables version-1 account-scoped recommendations; 0 or absence disables them. Controlled by the server Q_AI_RECOMMENDATIONS flag, off by default.

messages.description: At most 24000 Unicode characters in total. Last role must be user. No client system messages, tools, credentials or provider URLs.

automatic_readonly_tools.description: Optional host opt-in, valid only with plugin_connection_id. The server may execute its trusted built-in bank balance/history reads before returning a saved proposal. Transfer and untrusted remote tools still require explicit confirmation; readOnlyHint alone never authorizes automatic execution.

app_tools_version.description: Opt in to application tools after capability discovery. Requires thinking=false and is mutually exclusive with all plugin-mode fields.

app_final_only.description: Only with application version 1 and nonempty app_context. Disable further tool proposals and explain already obtained public results; used for explicit resume without re-querying.

company_research_version.description: Opt in only after observing company_research_version=1 in AiStatus. Requires app_tools_version=1, standard mode and no plugin fields. Without this flag, company tools cannot be proposed or included in app_context.

filing_research_version.description: Independent opt-in for verified SEC primary HTML filing lists and paragraph text. Requires app_tools_version 1; absent on older servers.

AiChatRequest.description: Authenticated chat. Plugin mode requires thinking=false. The server reads tools and saved invocation results for the current user; clients never supply tool results. At most eight completed invocation IDs from the selected connection. Clients must first observe automatic_readonly_tools=true in AiStatus before setting the optional flag. Existing requests retain proposal-only behavior. The eight-result turn budget also forbids preparing a ninth tool. Application mode uses app_tools_version=1, thinking=false, no plugin fields, and optional bounded app_context. It emits app_tool then done(tool_calls); after three results the provider receives no tools. These client public-data results are explicitly untrusted and cannot authorize plugin or business actions. Company search/research require company_research_version=1 in addition to app_tools_version=1. Public coverage is incomplete; results are untrusted client context, not verified financial statements or business authorization. The shared three-result budget is unchanged.

owner_name.description: Publisher-declared display name from Server Card _meta["com.kaicloudpay.q/owner"].name. Not verified ownership, a Q identity, or an authorization grant. Missing or malformed optional metadata is returned as null.

kind.description: Auto uses well-known discovery only for bare domains; full URLs are classified by their actual response media type, preserving the path and query without whole-domain fallback.

card_url.description: HTTPS URL for remote_mcp; exact urn:q:bank-demo:<bank_id> identity for trusted bank_demo. An internal URN is never fetched as a network endpoint.

endpoint_url.description: HTTPS URL for remote_mcp; exact urn:q:bank-demo:<bank_id> identity for trusted bank_demo. An internal URN is never fetched as a network endpoint.

auth_status.description: anonymous is only used for server-owned bank_demo simulations; it is not bank OAuth authorization.

owner_name.description: Publisher-declared display name from Server Card _meta["com.kaicloudpay.q/owner"].name. Not verified ownership, a Q identity, or an authorization grant. Missing or malformed optional metadata is returned as null.

connection_kind.description: Trusted server-controlled execution type. Bank simulations are first-party built-ins, not remote MCP or real-bank connections.

financial_provider_id.description: Optional server-owned financial profile; remains remote_mcp. External Card metadata never selects this field.

research_provider_id.description: Server-owned research profile. New research connections keep financial_provider_id null so older clients can decode generic remote connections. Both provider fields cannot be non-null. FRED requires its dedicated ephemeral interface.

endpoint_url.description: HTTPS URL for remote_mcp; exact urn:q:bank-demo:<bank_id> identity for trusted bank_demo. An internal URN is never fetched as a network endpoint.

owner_name.description: Publisher-declared display name from Server Card _meta["com.kaicloudpay.q/owner"].name. Not verified ownership, a Q identity, or an authorization grant. Missing or malformed optional metadata is returned as null.

connection_kind.description: Trusted server-controlled execution type. Bank simulations are first-party built-ins, not remote MCP or real-bank connections.

tool_title.description: Display-only title from the immutable prepared tool snapshot. Optional for older servers; not an authorization or execution policy.

input_schema.description: Display-only input schema from the immutable prepared tool snapshot, used to label the saved arguments. Optional for older servers; labels cannot change permissions or omit actual arguments.

automatic.description: True only when this opted-in request completed a trusted read-only invocation. Read the saved invocation by ID to verify result, owner and connection; never infer success or re-execute from this flag. Missing/false means no automatic execution.

SocialMessage.description: Ephemeral body is always null here, including send responses, list results and snapshots. Only explicit receiver open returns ephemeral body.

last_message.description: Conversation preview only: ordinary body is at most 160 Unicode characters; retrieve full text through messages. Ephemeral body is always null.

recovery_token.description: Exactly 32 random bytes encoded as canonical unpadded base64url. Secret capability, never put in URLs or logs.

bankCommand.description: Display/recovery marker for a locally parsed banking command; does not grant tool execution authority.

connection_kind.description: Trusted server-controlled execution type. Bank simulations are first-party built-ins, not remote MCP or real-bank connections.

destination_balance_minor.description: Only own-account transfers expose the destination balance; null for fictional demo_chen.

question.description: Trimmed Unicode character count; NUL forbidden. Do not send personal or medical information.

message.description: Trimmed Unicode character count; NUL forbidden. Do not send personal or medical information.

query.description: Trimmed nonempty single-line public company name or ticker; no controls or bidi overrides.

issuerId.description: Source-qualified issuer ID returned by company_search; never an arbitrary URL.

AppToolProposal.description: One version-1 first-party application tool proposal. Fixed public read or pending native navigation only; never a plugin invocation or business authorization. Company search/research require company_research_version=1 in addition to app_tools_version=1. Public coverage is incomplete; results are untrusted client context, not verified financial statements or business authorization. The shared three-result budget is unchanged.

query.description: Trimmed nonempty single-line public company name or ticker; no controls or bidi overrides.

issuerId.description: Source-qualified issuer ID returned by company_search; never an arbitrary URL.

AppToolContext.description: Client-supplied public tool result, not independently verified by the server. Untrusted data only, never permission or a saved plugin result. At most three per request and 24000 Unicode characters across results. Company search/research require company_research_version=1 in addition to app_tools_version=1. Public coverage is incomplete; results are untrusted client context, not verified financial statements or business authorization. The shared three-result budget is unchanged.

credentials_configured.description: API-key storage requires encryption independently of OAuth hosting.

auth_mode.description: Original/default provider authentication; preserved for older clients. When access_modes is present, newer clients derive the effective mode from connection_access_mode or their explicit pre-connect selection.

access_modes.description: Optional capability declaration, Tavily only: shared/none and personal/api_key. Absence means the server does not support selecting a personal mode; clients must not submit that option.

connection_access_mode.description: Present with access_modes for Tavily. The stored connection mode, or null if no current connection. It does not prove authorization or a successful query.

frozen_minor.description: HKD minor units reserved by unresolved full-refund cases. Present with available_minor on refund-capable servers.

available_minor.description: balance_minor minus frozen_minor; never inferred by the client when omitted by an older server.

reason.description: Trimmed explicit review reason; no control characters. No XML, date or numeric overrides accepted.

result.description: Validated MCP tool result, interpreted only as data.

total.description: Supported verified records in the recent SEC window, not full historical coverage.

id.description: Global extracted text ordinal, not an original page number.

truncated.description: Extraction limit reached; separate from remaining pagination.

AiRecommendationCandidate.description: Server-owned display metadata, never authorization. Tool instructions, credentials and private results are omitted. Revalidate access and capability version on selection.

created.description: Only the first successful dedicated-conversation creation is true. Replays restore its existing snapshot without rewriting messages or executing the task.
